title: Wilcoxon signed-rank test with the Hodges-Lehmann pseudo-median change
summary: A rank test for paired data whose changes are symmetric but not normal, reported as the pseudo-median change with its exact 95% interval.

sizing._why: No signed-rank form is in the catalog; sizing one needs an assumed distribution of the changes, which is a simulation or a stated efficiency approximation.

pinned_defaults: R: paired = TRUE, exact = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE, after first. conf.int defaults to FALSE; exact falls back to a normal approximation with zeros, ties or 50+ pairs.

Python: V is computed as the sum of the ranks of the POSITIVE changes (R's convention). scipy.stats.wilcoxon's two-sided statistic is min(W+, W-), which is a different number whenever most changes are positive; only its exact p-value is used.
_symmetry: The signed-rank test and the pseudo-median assume the changes are symmetric about their centre. With clearly skewed changes neither answers a question about a typical change.
